Title: Enhanced coagulant and Baal's Blood Talon

Messages.Author: Sambomb
Messages.Body:
vdb.im/cards/102238
vdb.im/cards/100121

Enhanced Coagulant
Weapon.
Strike: 3 unpreventable damage and put this card on the opposing vampire; it becomes a card with "Cards requiring a Discipline cost this vampire +1 blood. After this vampire successfully hunts, burn this card".

Relevant rulling:
Once used, it becomes a typeless card and cannot be used as a weapon anymore. [ANK 20220818]

Baal's Bloody Talons
Only usable before resolution of a melee weapon's strike.
Damage from this weapon's strikes is aggravated this round. Burn this weapon at the end of this round.
Quietus As above, and this weapon inflicts +1 aggravated damage each strike this round.

Does the coagulant stay on the target ?

Burn this weapon at the end of this round.

Since it becomes a typeless card, the target "this weapon" doesn't exist anymore.
